ecosystem.notes: Total revenue is mostly interest income on credit cards and loans, not fees on purchase volume, so Revenue / PV is not Nubank's take on card spending. The revenue directly tied to PV is interchange: the 20-F says "For the year ended December 31, 2024, total interchange fees was US$1,380.5 million, equivalent to 1.1% of PV" (the filing's sentence then says "over the year ended December 31, 2023", which appears to be a drafting slip). PV covers credit and prepaid cards only and excludes Pix.
